query: UPDATE assistant_batches SET state=CASE WHEN state IN ('completed','cancelled','expired') THEN state WHEN $5 THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'paused' END,reason=CASE WHEN state='completed' THEN NULL WHEN state IN ('cancelled','expired') THEN reason ELSE $6 END,finished_at=coalesce(finished_at,now()) WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND login_id=$3 AND id=$4
